comments: The second half of the show is all import albums. Tommy thanks Mike Shannon of Shades Records fame and various Kerrang! Journalists for their help with the research.
Session band are Badlands, not to be confused with the American band of the same name from the late 80s with Ray Gillen and Jake E Lee.
Tommy reckons the FNC is ‘quite complicated’ and gives a clue which may or may not assist!
Tony Wilson is in the studio and speaks at the end!

sessions.details: recorded 22 June 1984. Paul George (drums), Tut Skillin (vocals), Murray Ward (bass), Dave Flett (guitar), Mel The Axe (guitar)
